description: The Government intends to procure twenty (20) eRM equipment racks, to be installed on the following U.S. Navy vessels: DDG-56, DDG-113, DDG-115, LCS-27, LSD-50, DDG-125, DDG-122, DDG-140, DDG-141, DDG-142, DDG-143, DDG-144, DDG-145, DDG-146, DDG-147, DDG-148, DDG-149 as well as three (3) additional lab units to be delivered to the Naval Surface Warfare Center Philadelphia Division (NSWCPD).
